t.zh: <part-ref to="resizeNearest"></part-ref>只会照抄：新像素的值只能是原图里已有的某一个，[0, 1] 放大成 3 像素，中间那个不是 0 就是 1。这一关的问题是：新像素落在两个旧像素之间时，它只能等于其中一个吗？
t.en: The <part-ref to="resizeNearest"></part-ref> only copies: a new pixel can take only a value the original already has, so [0, 1] enlarged to 3 pixels has a middle of either 0 or 1. This level asks: when a new pixel falls between two old ones, must it equal one of them?

t.zh: 测试要的是：[0, 1] 放大成 3 像素时，中间那个是 0.5。这一关的图都只有一行。搭出的元件输入一张图和新的宽、高，交出缩放后的图，测试和隐藏测试的每个值都对才算对。
t.en: The tests want [0, 1] enlarged to 3 pixels to have 0.5 in the middle. This level's images are all one row high. The part takes an image and a new width and height and gives the resized image, right when every value in the tests and hidden tests is.

desc.zh: 输入一张图和新的宽 w、高 h，输出缩放后的图：每个新像素由左右两个旧像素按距离加权
desc.en: Takes an image and a new width w and height h; gives the resized image, each new pixel weighted from the old pixels to its left and right by distance

after.zh: 这是<wiki-ref to="linear-interpolation"></wiki-ref>：两边按距离加权，权重之和为 1，新值介于两边之间。
after.en: This is <wiki-ref to="linear-interpolation"></wiki-ref>: the two sides weighted by distance, the weights summing to 1, the new value lying between them.

brief.zh: 输入一行像素和新的宽、高：交出缩放后的图，每个新像素的值取自它左右两个旧像素。
brief.en: Given a row of pixels and a new width and height, give the resized image, each new pixel's value taken from the two old pixels on its left and right.

hint.zh: 中间那个新像素离左右两个旧像素各有多远？
hint.en: How far is the middle new pixel from each of the two old ones?

hint.zh: 先找出新位置左边那个旧像素，再算新位置离它有多远。
hint.en: First find the old pixel to the left of the new position, then how far the position is from it.

hint.zh: 两端的新位置落在原图之外：取像素可以设成取最近的边。
hint.en: The new positions at the ends fall outside the original: the lookup can be set to read the nearest edge.
